item.title: U.S. Raises Threat of Steep Water Cuts in Lower Colorado River Basin

item.title: Missteps Mount in Justice Dept.’s Case Against Minnesota Anti-ICE Protesters
item.description: The problems plaguing the case have not only hurt the government’s chances, lawyers say, but have also undermined the bonds of trust that prosecutors have traditionally enjoyed in court.

item.title: In Area Hit by Blaze, French Officials Failed to Enforce Wildfire Rules
item.description: Under French rules, homeowners must clear vegetation within roughly 50 yards of their houses. In the forests affected by France’s worst fire in decades, that didn’t happen.

item.media:description: A burned area in the town of Le Porge on Monday, following a wildfire in southwestern France.

item.title: Civilians Battle Wildfire Threatening Bordeaux
item.description: Residents in Bordeaux in southwestern France are doing everything in their power to stop a wildfire that’s been burning for more than a week. The flames are too spread out for professional firefighters to be everywhere, so for now, civilian volunteers are the only thing standing between the fire and a major French city.
item.dc:creator: Alex Pena, Bethlehem Feleke, Michael Anthony Adams and Mark Boyer

item.title: What to Know About the Deadly Wildfires Raging in Western Europe

item.media:description: Firefighters in Lège-Cap-Ferret, France, less than 30 miles west of Bordeaux, on Friday.
